# PasteSafe

> A free browser tool that masks API keys, passwords and personal data (PII) in logs, stack traces and configs before you paste them into ChatGPT or other AI.

PasteSafe scans pasted or dropped text with more than 200 secret rules from gitleaks, plus checks for private keys, JWTs, Bearer headers, passwords in URLs and connection strings, .env values, emails, IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, card numbers (Luhn check), IBANs (checksum) and phone numbers. Each unique value becomes a stable placeholder such as AWS_ACCESS_KEY_1 or EMAIL_2, so the AI's answer still makes sense, and placeholders in the AI's reply can be turned back into the real values.

Everything runs in the browser, in a Web Worker with no network code. The page's Content Security Policy forbids network connections, nothing is stored (no cookies, local storage or accounts), and the placeholder map lives only in the tab's memory. After the first visit it also works offline.

Known key formats are caught reliably. Plain passwords, names and street addresses in free text can slip through, so read the cleaned text before pasting it. The source is MIT licensed.

## Guides

- [All guides](https://pastesafe.vibe-coding.fans/guides/): step by step guides to masking secrets and personal data before sharing text
- [How to mask PII in logs](https://pastesafe.vibe-coding.fans/guides/mask-pii-in-logs/): what counts as PII in logs, masking it in a copy, sed alternatives, and logging less of it
- [How to mask sensitive data in logs](https://pastesafe.vibe-coding.fans/guides/mask-sensitive-data-in-logs/): redaction in pino, Python logging, Logback, Log4j 2 and Go slog
- [How to sanitize logs before you share them](https://pastesafe.vibe-coding.fans/guides/sanitize-logs-before-sharing/): a checklist for GitHub issues, tickets, chat and AI, with gitleaks and sed
- [Is it safe to paste code and logs into ChatGPT?](https://pastesafe.vibe-coding.fans/guides/is-it-safe-to-paste-code-into-chatgpt/): what happens to pasted text and what to take out first
- [What to do if you leaked an API key](https://pastesafe.vibe-coding.fans/guides/what-to-do-if-you-leaked-an-api-key/): revoke and rotate first, then check usage and clean up
- [How to remove a secret from git history](https://pastesafe.vibe-coding.fans/guides/remove-secrets-from-git-history/): git filter-repo, BFG, and the copies a force push does not reach
- [How to sanitize a HAR file](https://pastesafe.vibe-coding.fans/guides/sanitize-har-file/): what Chrome's sanitized export removes, jq cleanup, and masking the rest
- [How to mask credit card numbers in logs and text](https://pastesafe.vibe-coding.fans/guides/mask-credit-card-numbers/): the Luhn check, masking in code and sed, and PCI DSS display rules
- [How to share .env files securely](https://pastesafe.vibe-coding.fans/guides/share-env-file-safely/): secrets managers for values, masking for debugging
- [Is it safe to share a JWT token?](https://pastesafe.vibe-coding.fans/guides/is-it-safe-to-share-a-jwt/): what a JWT exposes, decoding it locally, and masking it
